label: Public health department
description: A local, district or state health department: epidemiology and disease surveillance, the public health laboratory, environmental health, clinics and immunizations, medical countermeasure dispensing, and the health officer's legal orders. Care delivery is the healthcare profile.

vocabulary.facility: the health department (district offices, clinics, the public health lab and the departmental operations center)
vocabulary.public: residents, clinicians and the communities the department serves
vocabulary.frontline: epidemiologists, disease investigators, public health nurses, environmental health specialists, lab scientists, call-center staff

it: disease surveillance and case management system (e.g. NBS or a commercial platform)
electronic laboratory reporting (ELR) and electronic case reporting (eCR) feeds
Health Alert Network messaging and partner mass notification
environmental health inspection and permitting database
public website, data dashboards and the call center
county shared services: email, directory, ERP and SIEM
ot: public health lab BSL-3 suite HVAC and directional airflow
vaccine refrigerators with remote temperature monitoring
access control and CCTV at the lab and clinics

roles.name: Health Officer / Health Director (Incident Commander)
roles.description: Issues health orders (isolation, quarantine, closure), declares a local public health emergency and sits in the policy group.

roles.name: Public Health Emergency Preparedness Coordinator
roles.description: Owns DOC activation, incident management staffing and the plans; seats the liaison in the county EOC (ESF-8).

roles.name: Lead Epidemiologist / Communicable Disease Manager
roles.description: Owns case definitions, contact tracing, the outbreak declaration and data release.

roles.name: Director of Environmental Health
roles.description: Owns restaurant and pool closures, drinking-water advisories with the water system, and food recalls.

roles.name: Medical Countermeasures / SNS Coordinator
roles.description: Owns Strategic National Stockpile requests and receipt, POD activation, security escort and the cold chain.

roles.name: IT Director / Informatics Lead
roles.description: Owns the surveillance systems, ELR and eCR feeds, the immunization registry and network isolation (often with county IT).

roles.name: Public Information Officer
roles.description: Owns HAN wording with the medical director, press and social media, rumor control and translation.

outsideParties: CDC (Emergency Operations Center, Epi-Aid, the PHEP program office)
ASPR (the Strategic National Stockpile, regional emergency coordinators)
the state health department and the state public health lab
county emergency management and the county EOC
the healthcare coalition, hospitals and infection preventionists
mediaChannels: a local TV health reporter's email
a viral TikTok or X post with false claims
a school district email to parents

sceneAnchors.public: a mass vaccination clinic in a school gymnasium: lines of residents, nurses at folding tables, signs with arrows, volunteers in vests, daylight through high windows
sceneAnchors.control: inside a health department operations center: staff at long tables with laptops, a wall of printed maps and outbreak charts, an incident command board, fluorescent lighting
sceneAnchors.exterior: a county public health department building with a parking lot, a white mobile clinic van, staff carrying coolers to a car, overcast sky

noiseExamples: a restaurant owner disputing an inspection score
a resident asking for a copy of a birth certificate
a vaccine shipment arriving a day early
a printer jam in the epidemiology office
pressureExamples: a viral review naming the wrong restaurant as the outbreak source
threatening voicemails to the health officer after a closure order
a deepfake video of the health officer announcing a mandatory quarantine
a reporter asking how many cases the department is not reporting
a county commissioner questioning the authority for the order
